providers.label: For providers
providers.heading: A clinical dashboard built for modern wellness medicine
points: Live patient roster with risk stratification and biological age across your entire panel.
Care plan builder: push diet, exercise, meditation, and medication plans to patients instantly.
Personalised recommendations that appear straight in each patient's dashboard.
Secure messaging with your patients, plus a shareable video meeting link for teleconsultations.
Clinical visits, diagnoses, and lab report history all in one place.

hospitals.label: For hospitals & wellness centres
hospitals.heading: Manage your entire clinical team from one portal
points: Multi-location management: add locations, assign providers to branches, and manage your full team.
Schedule management: set provider availability week by week.
Network analytics: active providers, patients, visit volume, and specialty mix across your locations.
Role-based access control: providers see only their own patients, hospital admins see their own network, and superadmins manage all hospitals.

secure.title: Encrypted and access-controlled
secure.body: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. You see your own records, and providers see only the patients connected to them.

notEmergency.title: Not emergency care
notEmergency.body: MELLOW is a wellness and preventive health platform. It is not a substitute for emergency medical care. If you have an urgent health concern, contact your doctor or emergency services immediately.

About.heading: Bringing the world's longevity research together
About.intro: Mellow Consortium is a global clinical research platform built to connect the people and institutions advancing human longevity. As a MusB Research Initiative, we link researchers, clinical sites, industry partners, and scientific publishers into one network, so the study of how we age becomes faster, more collaborative, and more rigorous.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.body: To advance science for longer, better lives by turning fragmented, siloed research into one harmonized body of global evidence that anyone in the field can build on.

whatWeDo.heading: What we do
whatWeDo.body: We give the longevity community shared infrastructure: harmonized study designs and endpoints, connected clinical sites, a publishing arm, and digital tools like MELLOW-Age that bring research to patients and providers. Together, these turn isolated findings into cumulative, comparable knowledge.

globalNetwork.heading: A global network
globalNetwork.body: MELLOW spans clinical sites across six continents, sharing placebo data and harmonized endpoints so results can be compared and combined worldwide.

getInvolved.heading: Get involved
getInvolved.body: Researchers, clinics, hospitals, and industry partners are all part of the MELLOW network. If your work touches longevity, there's a place for you here.

MellowAge.heading: Know your biological age. Improve how you age.
MellowAge.subheading: Turn your bloodwork into a clear picture of how your body is aging, plus a plan to change it.

howItWorks.heading: How MELLOW-Age works

step1.title: Share your labs
step1.body: Upload your routine blood test reports and share them with your connected provider. No new tests required.

step2.title: Your provider reviews them
step2.body: Your connected MELLOW provider reviews your results and biomarkers.

step3.title: Get your biological age
step3.body: Your provider records your biological age and risk level in your MELLOW record.

step4.title: Follow a personalized plan
step4.body: Your provider builds a care plan with you covering diet, exercise, meditation, and medications, visible in your dashboard.

howItWorks.disclaimer: Biological age is currently assessed and recorded by your connected provider. MELLOW does not calculate it automatically.

roadmap.heading: Where biological age intelligence is heading
roadmap.description: We're working toward new domain-specific aging scores, powered by emerging biomarker categories and AI. None of these are available yet.
